name: fhir-sync-pebble-core
description: Pure core of FHIR Sync for Pebble: the patients a `Patient` search lists (read leniently), the settings the watchapp receives (its wire shape, built from the SMART grant and the picked patient), the allow-listed Pebble `return_to` and the hand-off URL, and the store that keeps `return_to` across the SMART login. No DOM, no platform imports.
